caption: The drawing depicts an overhead view of a landscaped estate with a predominantly green color palette representing grass and trees. At the top, a tan road labeled "ROAD TO CHATHAM" curves from left to right, bordered by green trees with darker green shading. Below the road, two parallel rows of evenly spaced trees form a long avenue leading straight down the center of the estate. Between these rows is a narrow, rectangular water feature or path. To the left and right of the avenue, scattered individual trees and small wooded clusters dot the open grassy area. Midway down the avenue, six white or light-colored sculptures or fountains are symmetrically arranged in two rows of three. Below is a circular drive or paved area, with two red-roofed, rectangular structures flanking it. Further down, there are four intricately patterned formal garden beds in blue, white, and red hues, arranged symmetrically around a central circular feature. To the right of the garden beds are plots that appear to be greenhouses, orchards, or crops, with a rectilinear layout. At the left edge and right edge of the estate drawing, groups of brightly colored flowers, including red, white, blue, and purple blossoms, decorate the corners. At the top left, an inset black-and-white illustration depicts a house, encircled by additional clusters of flowers. At the bottom right, a tan scroll contains text about "THE LADY WARREN ESTATE," and is decorated with floral elements. The composition presents the estate's arranged elements in a formal, symmetrical plan viewed from above, surrounded by artistic floral borders.
title: Warren Estate
